applies_why: The judge text grounds a STANDS line partly on a verse/family not stating the contrary, which is the kind of non-statement ground K-S2 governs.
quote: D3: STANDS -- GROUND: C5’s offering-purpose reading is answered in CR2 D, and the “her seed” family pressed earlier does not state that Jesus had a human father.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: The phrase 'That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary': (1) it bars only an express one-verse-silence rationale; (2) it bars any STANDS ground that a verse or family 'does not state' the link or contrary. I read it as (2).
why: D3's STANDS ground includes that the “her seed” family does not state that Jesus had a human father, using a verse-based non-statement as a ground for STANDS in breach of K-S2.
